leadingTextureLift.formula: delta(m_nu)_(PP) = -2 y_P c_D v^2 / (lambda_M Lambda) + O(r_N^2)
leadingTextureLift.interpretation: the common charge-three VEV cancels between Dirac leakage and rank-restoring Majorana sewing

positiveResult: the renormalizable symmetric-phase counterterm basis can contain the required Majorana sewing without containing the dangerous Dirac cross Yukawa
boundary: the gauge-invariant dimension-five Dirac operator is allowed in the EFT and at heavy thresholds; exact protection still requires an incidence rule, Ward identity or UV matching condition that sets its coefficient to zero
verdict: operator dimension supplies a suppression moat, not an exact texture-zero theorem
